description: The campaign map is a hand-finished Photoshop raster. The vector pipeline that produced its base is retired as a renderer (2026-09-11) but survives as geometry and as ground truth: data/map/frames/kurose-12km.json still says where the page is and how it is turned, and data/map/kurose.gpkg still holds 230,061 real features under it. This manifest is what joins the picture to both.

image.note: Maintained by hand in Photoshop. Still sitting in the in-tray; it wants a permanent home under artwork/ and an asset-registry entry, which is a decision about where, not a technical blocker.

pageFurniture.note: The title and legend block, printed over the bay in the bottom-right corner of the content area. Its cream fill (215, 196, 171) reads as land, which put three square kilometres of reclaimed ground in open water and gave the region tessellation two districts made entirely of legend. The ground underneath it is sea. Measured from the box's own dark border rule at x=9600 and y=11000.

controlPoints.label: mountain-front
controlPoints.note: Shin-Kobe Station at the foot of the mountain front -- the sharpest edge on the map.

controlPoints.label: harbour-edge
controlPoints.note: The Port Tower and the inner harbour quays; built waterfront the op log never touched.

controlPoints.label: city-grid
controlPoints.note: Sannomiya's dense regular street grid -- where a sub-metre offset would beat visibly against the painting.

controlPoints.label: river-mouth
controlPoints.note: The Minatogawa channel; a hard line no amount of painting moves.
